verdict.line: You lose if you all-in into an unpopped Death's Caress shield or walk into a brush-cast Cryptic Gaze; you win if you interrupt his Q with E and burst him down in the gap before his shield resets.

brief.thesis: Irelia holds lane advantage and the solo-kill edge here, but the 43% head-to-head win rate over 100 games (against her 49.9% baseline) says that edge is fragile early: Sion's Death's Caress shield and Cryptic Gaze stun can stonewall an all-in before Irelia's own tools — passive stacks, E as an interrupt — come online. Once E is reliably up around level 3, the trade math flips hard in her favor.

theirWindow.when: Sion sitting in brush with Q ready
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze is 550 range and single-target — don't walk forward blind. Clear the brush or hold minions between you until you've confirmed his Q is down (12/11/10/9/8s cooldown by rank).

yourWindow.what: Engage immediately — at max stacks you gain bonus on-hit damage plus the attack speed, and OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to take lane control exactly here. Open with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun+Mark, then Q (Bladesurge) resets off the Mark.

start.why: The run-away pick at 46.6% win rate over 118 games and 92.9% pick rate — the extra sustain and early AD help you survive Sion's Enrage-boosted trades before you have items.

boots.why: 46.8% win rate, 67% pick rate — Sion's damage is almost entirely auto-attacks powered by Enrage, so flat armor reduction hits harder than magic resist here.

core.why: On-hit damage scales off his current health, which only grows as his passive stacks max HP from kills — BORK keeps shredding him no matter how tanky he gets.
Rewards dueling and split-pushing, which is exactly how you want to spend side-lane time against a champion whose real power is teamfight sustain.
This path hit 56.3% win rate over 16 games — the damage delay and physical reduction let you tank an Enrage-boosted auto exchange and still come out ahead.

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.5% win rate at 45.4% pick — the stacking adaptive force and sustain reward exactly the kind of extended, repeated-trade duel this matchup turns into once you can interrupt his Q.

summoners.why: 48.5% win rate at 76.2% pick — with the measured solo-kill advantage already in your favor, Ignite converts your 4-stack all-in windows into actual kills instead of just pushed-out trades.

playing.title: Bank stacks before committing
playing.detail: Land E or Q on a minion or on Sion in a safe trade first so you're entering the real all-in already near 4 Ionian Fervor stacks, not starting from zero.

playing.title: Interrupt Q with E
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze is a single-target stun on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown — firing E (Flawless Duet) while he's casting it stuns and Marks him first, voiding his attempt.

playing.title: Punish the shield's downtime
playing.detail: Death's Caress is only an 8s cooldown, but once it's popped or expired Sion has zero damage mitigation for that window — dash in with Q (Bladesurge) the instant it drops.

playing.title: Respect brush-cast range
playing.detail: 550 range covers more brush than it looks like — don't walk up without vision or a minion wave between you.

playing.title: Charge W into his all-in
playing.detail: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while charging — hold the charge through his Enrage-boosted auto, then release the full-value strike back into him.

playing.title: Chain Marks into free Q resets
playing.detail: Bladesurge refreshes its cooldown on a Marked or dying target — landing E or R first turns every follow-up Q into a free extra dash.

playing.title: Split-push after 6
playing.detail: His real power spike is Cannibalism's teamfight healing, not a 1v1 spike — pulling him into side-lane duels denies him the stage where that ultimate matters.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, cooldown numbers, and the tactical read on when to trade or all-in are this brief's own analysis.
